segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the seat count and the timing so I can get the order form cleaned up. Last note I have is 48 standard seats and 6 admin seats for the June 17 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add two more admins later, but for the initial contract it's 54 total users, with 6 of those admins.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. And on pricing, the quote is $38,880 annually before tax, billed up front. That includes onboarding at $3,200 as a one-time services line. Does that match what you saw?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that lines up. Finance just asked if the invoice can reference PO 4719 and break out the onboarding fee separately.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. I'll put the PO number in the billing notes and keep the subscription and services as separate lines on the invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. One other thing, legal had a small redline on auto-renewal. They want 60 days' notice instead of 90.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I checked with deal desk this morning, and 60 days is fine for a 12-month term. I'll have the contract terms updated and send the revised version today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If we sign by Friday, are we still on track for the kickoff next Tuesday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If signature is in by May 31, we can hold the June 4 kickoff. The implementation lead already has the project slot reserved, and we'd target admin training on June 11.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send the updated order form to me and copy Marcus in procurement.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it over in the next hour, and once it's signed, the billing tool will generate the invoice with the PO reference.
